Game Overview

Gun Idle puts players into a shooter experience centered on arm yourself for a relentless zombie onslaught. Master the art of nimble movement and rapid-fire shooting to keep the eerie void-like creatures at bay. Gather coins to enhance your firepower, ensuring no zombie breaches the critical pink line. Survive, upgrade, and conquer the undead menace!

Getting started in Gun Idle doesn't take long to learn. Arm yourself for a relentless zombie onslaught!
